Karnali Yaks registered a clinical 24-run win over Chitwan Rhinos, defending 153/8 by bowling them out for 129 in 19.1 overs!
Karnali Yaks delivered a disciplined bowling display to defend their total and secure a vital win in Match 27 of the Nepal Premier League 2026!
